meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科研与技术内容并提取网页信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从互联网搜索学术或技术资料并提取全文内容
copy.tagline_en: Search scientific and technical content and extract webpage information
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search the web for academic or technical content and extract full-text information

howto.what: 安装后，当你需要搜索网络或获取网页内容时，Claude 会使用 Exa 工具进行搜索（尤其擅长科学和技术内容），或批量获取网址（网页、文章、学术 PDF）。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索、查找信息、获取某个页面或提取文章内容时，Claude 会触发此技能。

say.text: 帮我搜索最新的量子计算论文。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Exa 搜索并优先显示学术来源。
Claude 会提取该页面的正文。

howto.what_en: When you need to search the web or fetch URL content, Claude uses Exa to perform searches (especially for scientific/technical topics) or batch-fetch web pages, articles, and academic PDFs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article from a URL.

say_en.text: Search for recent papers on quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude searches Exa prioritizing scholarly sources.

say_en.text: Fetch content from this URL: https://example.com/article
say_en.note: Claude extracts the page's main content.
